route_bound: Per-job counterfactual route draws, minimum inference over AP26..60, positive-system LP; includes CPU/route slot work and union constraints; continuous assignment relaxation ignores deadlines and ordering, not an achievable schedule or certified physical bound.
bound_gate: Report bound first; if optimistic margin >=5% at85%, perform finite balanced training. Feasible energy-only control also reports service losses.
CPU3: Same CENTRAL timing/interference and nonzero service work; up to3 concurrent CPU grants. Logical route slots CPU/GPU/NPU remain1 each. Extra core power is unidentified; report grant overlap and break-even power, no measured multithreading claim.
balanced_reward: TRAIN-frozen reference medians normalize incremental energy and excess AP. Urgent/normal miss cost normalized by each class; tail penalty reduced from.2 to.02. Lagrange multipliers adapt to TRAIN reference on-time target minus0.5pp, no action guard. Per-objective actor advantage RMS balancing prevents one cost unit from dominating.
training: 16 episodes x3 seeds x2 CPU scenarios; identical parent weights, fresh Adam/RNG. 8 PPO updates each. Preserve all weights, frames, failures. Frozen parent and energy-only public rolling controls included.
evaluation: DEV 6 conditions and fresh EVAL 12 conditions,8 policies perCPU scenario. Freeze representative seed before EVAL; report all3 seeds, all inputs, class rates, response P95, allAVAILABLE, total API-J and temperatures.
selection: DEV only: minimize squared on-time deficits >0.5pp vs frozen RL separately for urgent/normal; then normalized energy+thermal, then seed. This selects checkpoints, never masks or replaces actions.
WAIT: Balanced/energy-only keep all physical-legal dispatch candidates and WAIT. Remove old artificial total12s/head1.5s wait caps; retain registered dispatch_stop and horizon. Frozen RL preserves old caps. No deadline mask or forced choice.
